Subject: Unexpected Q3 usage spike & retro charges — help request

Hi Hannah,

We just received the June invoice and there are significant retroactive overage charges for May that we weren't expecting (~$48k). Our engineering team enabled a large batch of inference jobs late May while testing a new feature; the burst was non-production but still billed. We have an existing reserved capacity commit for Q3, and Carlos flagged that some of that May usage could have been covered by the commit if the term amendment had been applied earlier.

Can you confirm:
- Exact usage windows for the disputed charges (May 20–26)
- Whether any of this can be applied to our upcoming Q3 commit (we are preparing to increase from 200k to 320k tokens/day equivalent)
- If Redwood offers a one-time settlement or credit in situations like this

We'd like to avoid a hard hold on the PO cycle — can someone from Billing/Sales advise?

Thanks,
Amelia
Billing Lead, Datasprout

Hi Amelia — thanks for the note and the detail. I've pulled the threads into this email so Ben (your AE) and Monica (CS) can triage the usage and propose a path forward. Quick answers up front:

- We'll validate the exact token/time slices for May 20–26 and flag anything that looks like testing/burst traffic.
- We can consider applying a portion of the retro usage against the new Q3 commit as a one-time top-up if the team agrees to amend the term and commit by signature.
- Settlement options: (a) partial credit toward the Q3 commit; (b) one-time amortized credit across next two invoices; (c) standard invoice adjustment if an error is identified.

Ben — can you propose a settlement figure and the documentation you need (PO/Amendment)? Monica — please attach the usage export for May 18–28 and highlight non-prod agents if available.

Amelia — I'll aim to have a formal proposal in 24–48 hours.

Best,

Hi Amelia — attaching a short settlement proposal after reviewing usage with the ops team. Summary below and attached PDF:

Proposal summary (Datasprout, May 20–26 spike):
- Confirmed burst = 4.9M tokens (non-prod flagged by tag: test-run-2026-05)
- Raw overage billed = $48,360
- Proposed one-time resolution:
  1) Apply 60% of the overage ($29,016) as a credit toward your Q3 commit if you sign the amendment to increase committed capacity to 320k tokens/day (term starts 2026-07-01).
  2) Remaining 40% ($19,344) to be amortized across your next two monthly invoices (split equally).
  3) We will reissue an adjusted invoice for May that shows the credit applied and a note linking to the amendment.

Docs needed to proceed: signed amendment (I attached a draft), PO for the additional commit (or confirmation of the pipeline), and a short note from your finance team approving the credit application.

If you prefer a different split (for example 50/50), say so and we can move quickly. We can also add a spike protection clause to the amendment (monthly smoothing up to 25% over commit) if that helps you avoid future surprises.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
